required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 30 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline engineering_branch?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as advisory/background only?
Was the previous accepted baseline identified as decision_20260708_state_domain_taxonomy_final_status_rework_v1?
Was the User Solve Contract roadmap basis inspected?
Were existing user_solve / solve_contract / solve_state modules searched before adding new code?
Did the round avoid duplicating existing User Solve functionality if found?
Is UserSolveTask defined with schema_version and stable identity fields?
Is UserSolveResult defined with status, validation_status, candidates, message, confidence, and evidence refs?
Is CandidateResult defined without implying runtime validation?
Is ValidationStatus defined so candidate_found, static_verified, and runtime_validated are distinct?
Are failed and blocked reason codes explicit and serializable?
Does the state transition validator reject illegal transitions?
Does the state transition validator require evidence refs for verified/runtime_validated states?
Does candidate_found allow validation_status=pending?
Does runtime_validated require runtime validation evidence and not just static evidence?
Does blocked carry a reason such as policy/tool/environment/sample_format/unsupported?
Does the user-facing payload avoid exposing raw decision_packet, command-plan, negative_results, or internal gate file bodies?
Are JSON serialization/deserialization tests deterministic?
Are backward/forward compatibility rules documented for unknown optional fields?
Did pytest run and pass with explicit command recorded in pytest_result.txt?
Did command-plan include explicit pytest, report-summary, execution-log, final-check, run-closeout, and close-round?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Were project_state/current_state.json and task_packet.json left untouched?
Were artifact_index, negative_results, state_manifest, context, roadmap, domains, frontend, workflows, solve_reports, and training materials left untouched?
Did final-check pass or accurately reflect any limitations?
Did run-closeout and close-round pass and generate a round_manifest for this round?
Do execution_report.md and codex_execution_report.md agree on decision_id, round_id, status, acceptance_recommendation, tests_ran, and generated_artifacts?
